leads.arxiv: 2609.17688 (arXiv API: v1 2026-09-15; title: CapMem: A Benchmark for Caption-Based Episodic Memory in Egocentric Video)

community_list_entries.name: CapMem: A Benchmark for Caption-Based Episodic Memory in Egocentric Video

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Human-annotated benchmark for episodic memory over egocentric video: 75 videos (33.7 h, mostly Ego4D plus six other egocentric datasets), 1,000 MCQs across 16 scenarios. Paper says annotations released for non-commercial research but gives no URL.
